entity.name: Travis Fischer
entity.description: Open source developer. Creator and maintainer of react-notion-x and its notion-* packages (notion-client, notion-types, notion-utils, notion-compat and notion-x-to-md), which power tens of thousands of Notion-backed websites, along with related projects such as nextjs-notion-starter-kit.

projects.name: react-notion-x
projects.description: Fast and accurate React renderer for Notion. Renders Notion pages and databases with full TypeScript support, SSR and lazy-loaded heavy components. Used in production by tens of thousands of websites.

projects.name: notion-client
projects.description: Robust TypeScript client for the unofficial Notion API. Fetches full Notion pages and databases and runs in Node.js, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes.

projects.name: notion-types
projects.description: TypeScript types for core Notion data structures, shared by react-notion-x and the other notion-* packages.

projects.name: notion-utils
projects.description: Useful utilities for working with Notion data. Supports any JS environment including browsers.

projects.name: notion-compat
projects.description: Compatibility layer between the official Notion API and the unofficial private API, so official API data can be rendered with react-notion-x.

projects.name: notion-x-to-md
projects.description: Converts a Notion page to Markdown. Very useful for LLMs.

channels.description: Bank transfer. Email travis@transitivebullsh.it for account details.

plans.name: Maintenance
plans.description: Ongoing maintenance of react-notion-x and its notion-* packages: keeping up with changes to Notion's data format and block types, fixing rendering bugs, triaging issues, reviewing pull requests and publishing releases.
